set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess
root=Path('/srv/projects/pink-iptv/backend')
venv=root/'.venv'
for path in ['/root/pink-iptv','/root/pink-iptv/backend/.venv/bin/python3','/srv/pink-iptv/backend/.venv/bin/python3',str(venv/'bin/python3')]:
 p=Path(path)
 print('PYTHON_PATH',path,'EXISTS',p.exists(),'SYMLINK',p.is_symlink(),'REAL',str(p.resolve()) if p.exists() else 'NONE')
scripts=[]
for f in (venv/'bin').iterdir():
 if not f.is_file() or f.is_symlink():continue
 try:
  if f.stat().st_size>150000:continue
  with f.open('rb') as inp:line=inp.readline()
  if line.startswith(b'#!'):
   text=line.decode(errors='replace').strip()
   scripts.append((f.name,text))
 except OSError:pass
print('SHEBANG_FILES_COUNT',len(scripts))
for name,s in scripts[:85]:
 print('ENTRY',name,s[:195])
cfg=venv/'pyvenv.cfg'
if cfg.is_file():
 print('PYVENV_CONFIG_PATH_REFERENCES',[(i+1,l[:220]) for i,l in enumerate(cfg.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()) if 'pink-iptv' in l])
def chk(args,t=12):
 try:
  r=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=t,cwd=str(root))
  return r.returncode,r.stdout.strip()[:200],r.stderr.strip()[:200]
 except Exception as e:return -2,'',type(e).__name__
print('PYTHON_TEST',chk([str(venv/'bin/python3'),'-c','import sys,uvicorn;print(sys.version.split()[0])']))
print('UVICORN_SHEBANG_TEST',chk([str(venv/'bin/uvicorn'),'--version']))
for name in ['pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn']:
 r=subprocess.run(['systemctl','show',name+'.service','-p','ActiveState','-p','MainPID','--no-pager'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 print('SYSTEMD',name,r.stdout.strip().replace('\n',' '))
dropin=Path('/etc/systemd/system/pink-iptv-backend.service.d')
print('DROPIN_FILES',','.join(x.name for x in dropin.iterdir()) if dropin.is_dir() else 'NONE')
print('PINK_ENTRYPOINT_PREFLIGHT_DONE')
PY
